structure: Single-grade Utah Core Standards for Elementary Social Studies (adopted Dec 2022). Pages 1-7 are front matter shared by every elementary file (cover, board list, introduction, organization of standards, one-paragraph overviews of K-6). Then one grade section with four or more strands (GRADE STRAND n: HISTORY/GEOGRAPHY/CIVICS/ECONOMICS) each with a strand description sentence ('Students will ...'), a bulleted list of Compelling Questions (marked with ']'), and numbered standards 'Standard G.S.N: text' (G=grade, S=strand, N=number). The 'Standard G.S.N' label and its text are sometimes split into two units (label at x=75, text at x=189), and in several files the label is missing from the units (it was moved to the running header) leaving just the text. Parenthetical 'for example' lists stay inside the standard unit. Fourth grade has five strands: Utah's Unique Geography; Pre-Expansion (before 1847); Expansion (1847-1896); Post-Statehood (1896-1999); A New Millenia (2000-present).
